about: Vectors for MPP's challenge pieces in the mpp entry point of @integraledger/lcp, shared by every MPP pairing. H is SHA-256("abc") from FIPS 180-2. C_E and C_T are fixed challenges; their request values are JSON, base64url without padding. Expected values were computed with eth-account 0.14.0, eth-abi 6.0.0, eth-utils 6.0.0 and pyrlp 5.0.0 on Python 3.12.3, viem 2.56.8 and GNU coreutils 9.4. MV9's field values are MPP's own example (draft-httpauth-payment-01 at 08e7dd87, lines 1427-1430).

MV1.case: challengeId(H, 0), and challengeH of it and of two ids that are not ours

MV3.case: place([C_E], H, link, C_E) and place([C_T], H, link, C_T); read of each

MV4.case: issuedDigest of C_E, of MV3's echoed challenge, of C_E with header, and of C_T and its echo

MV9.case: parseChallenges of MPP's two-challenge example, as two field values and joined with ", "
